name: Cali-Dragon Farm and Orchard
description: Cali-Dragon Farm and Orchard is an agritourism farm in 6714 De Anza Avenue, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Hours and availability change with the season, so confirm before visiting.
